festivals.what: Nachi no Ogi Matsuri (Nachi Fire Festival), the annual grand festival of Kumano Nachi Taisha: 14 July every year, with 12 fan-shaped portable shrines; preparation rites on 9, 11 and 13 July.

culture-cycles.note: Dates from the shrine, temple, organiser or city's own page, read directly 2026-11-05.

layers.process: The Ohechi Route of the Kumano Kodo is closed between Wabuka Station and Tako Station from 8 June 2026 to an estimated 30 April 2027, because of expressway construction. The bureau's notice of 31 May 2026 says to bypass this section by train or bus. A notice of 25 February 2026 says booking requests are taken only from 7:00 to 9:30 and 19:00 to 22:00 JST each day.

sources.title: Kumano Kodo updates
sources.supports: Ohechi closure and booking-request hours (read directly 2026-11-07)

zone-requirements.note: No other current closures were listed on the Nakahechi, Kohechi or Iseji routes. A 2023 Kohechi landslide detour is listed with no end date.
